parsed.restated: (∀ (r : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → ℝ) (b : Fin r → ℝ), MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy.Interlacing a b → s < 2 * MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy.Gamma a b → MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy.Phi a b < R → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ C : SpherePacking.SphericalCode n s, (C.points.card : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (R * (n : ℝ))) ∧ MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy.sphericalCodeRate s ≤ MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy.closedHierarchyVariationalRate s
parsed.english: For every interlacing pair (a,b) with s < 2·Gamma(a,b) and every R > Phi(a,b), there is a threshold N such that for all dimensions n ≥ N, every spherical code in dimension n with inner products ≤ s has fewer than 2^(R n) points. Also, the limsup spherical code rate is at most the closed hierarchy variational rate.
parsed.why_clearer: It replaces the filter statement ∀ᶠ n in atTop with an explicit 'there exists N such that for all n ≥ N' quantifier, and turns the implicit binders {r} {R} into explicit ones.
